shared_elements: carved low-relief decoration on a stone slab
justification: The most specific correspondence is that both are upright carved stone surfaces divided by horizontal bands/registers, with profile figures and disc-like motifs included among the relief decoration. The biggest difference is compositional: A is crowded with larger animal-like and abstract motifs on an irregular rectangular support, while B has a rounded-topped, framed, more symmetrical scene centered on standing human figures and ordered registers.
